title: Blissful Ackee Bowl
description: A vegan twist on a Jamaican classic, combining ackee with umami flavors and topped with fresh bliss.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add scallions and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add tofu and cook for 5 minutes, until golden brown.
Stir in umami mushroom broth and bring to a simmer.
Add ackee and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Sprinkle with nutritional yeast and serve topped with bliss.
Serve over rice or as a bowl with your favorite toppings.
